nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the collection name 'Alpha Pass'.
Public string state variable holding the collection symbol 'AP'.
Public uint256 cap on total minted tokens, default 1000, mutable by owner via setMaxSupply.
Public uint256 mint price per token, default 0.1 ether, mutable by owner via setCurrentPrice.
Public string base URI used to build token metadata URIs.
Mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking which whale token IDs have already been used to mint an Alpha Pass.
Internal uint256 counter of minted Alpha Passes, compared against maxSupply.
Hard-coded ERC721Enumerable reference used to check whale ownership and enumerate whale tokens.
Constructor initializing the ERC1155 base URI.
External payable mint function that validates payment, supply and whale ownership, then loops over whale tokens calling _mint.
Overridden view function returning the metadata URI for an existing token.
View function returning WhaleContract.totalSupply().
Owner-only setter for baseURI.
Owner-only setter for the mint price.
Owner-only setter for the maximum supply.
Caller-controlled address used for whale balance checks and as the mint recipient.
Multiplication price * amount used in the payment requirement in mint.
Internal ERC1155 _mint call that creates tokens and triggers receiver acceptance callbacks.
External call WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) whose result drives the mint loop bound.
External call WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender, i) returning the whale token id used for minting.
State write of the mint price inside setCurrentPrice.
State write of maxSupply inside setMaxSupply.
State write of baseURI inside setBaseUri.
Caller-supplied amount parameter of mint, used for payment check, supply check and loop break condition.
Token id parameter of uri used to check existence and build the returned URI.
New base URI string parameter of setBaseUri.
New price value parameter of setCurrentPrice.
New supply value parameter of setMaxSupply.
Local var caching WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender), the loop bound in mint.
Local counter of tokens minted in the current mint call.
Loop index over whale token enumeration in mint.
Local whale token id returned by WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex and used as the minted token id.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed directly into the external WhaleContract.balanceOf call, so an attacker-controlled address influences the mint loop bound.
msg.sender is passed into WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex to enumerate whale tokens of the caller.
msg.sender is used as the recipient address of the internal _mint call.
msg.sender enters the mint function and drives both the whale ownership check and the minted token selection.
The stored price state variable is an operand of the price * amount multiplication.
The untrusted amount parameter is multiplied with price, so payment validation depends on caller input.
The payment requirement price * amount <= msg.value gates execution of mint.
maxSupply is read in the totalMinted + amount <= maxSupply supply check inside mint.
The totalMinted counter is read and incremented inside mint, controlling the supply invariant.
The amount parameter is used for payment validation, the supply check and the loop break condition.
mint assigns the external balance of msg.sender to the wBalance local used as the loop bound.
mint initializes and increments the minted local counter across loop iterations.
mint initializes and advances the loop index i.
mint performs the external WhaleContract.balanceOf call.
mint performs external WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex calls inside an unbounded loop whose length is caller-controlled.
The wBalance local, derived from caller balance, bounds the loop that repeatedly calls tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
The loop index i is the second argument of the tokenOfOwnerByIndex enumeration call.
The whale token id returned by tokenOfOwnerByIndex is stored in the wTokenId local.
The externally-obtained wTokenId is used as the token id argument of the internal _mint call.
The mintedTokens mapping gates the _mint call so each whale token can only mint once.
mint calls the internal _mint which performs an external acceptance callback before the caller-visible loop state is finalized.
The minted counter is incremented around each _mint call, coupling loop state with the external-facing mint.
_mint triggers IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received on the recipient contract, which may re-enter mint before totalMinted/mintedTokens bookkeeping completes.
The tokenId parameter is checked against mintedTokens and embedded into the returned URI.
mintedTokens is read in uri to require that the requested token exists.
baseURI is concatenated with the stringified token id when building the URI.
The newUri parameter is written into storage by setBaseUri.
setBaseUri performs the storage write of baseURI.
The baseURI state variable is assigned by the setBaseUri storage write.
The newPrice parameter is written into the price state variable.
setCurrentPrice is onlyOwner-guarded yet can arbitrarily change the mint price used by mint.
The price state variable is assigned by the setCurrentPrice storage write.
The newSupply parameter is written into the maxSupply state variable.
setMaxSupply is onlyOwner-guarded yet can arbitrarily change the supply cap constraining mint.
The maxSupply state variable is assigned by the setMaxSupply storage write.
totalSupply forwards to the hard-coded WhaleContract ERC721Enumerable instance.
The constructor deploys the contract that exposes the mint entry point.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists as an input to mint and is fully consumed by its payment, supply and loop checks.
The tokenId parameter is exclusively used inside uri for existence checking and URI construction.
The newUri parameter flows directly into the baseURI storage write operation.
The newPrice parameter flows directly into the price storage write operation.
The newSupply parameter flows directly into the maxSupply storage write operation.
The wBalance local is solely the result of the external balanceOf call and bounds the mint loop.
The minted local is a per-call counter internal to the mint execution.
The loop index i exists only to enumerate whale tokens via repeated tokenOfOwnerByIndex calls.
The wTokenId local is exclusively used as the token id argument of the internal _mint call.
